title: Joash pays Hazael to spare Jerusalem
description: When Hazael, king of Aram, had captured Gath and turned his attention to Jerusalem, Joash king of Judah took all the sacred gifts that his fathers Jehoshaphat, Joram, and Ahaziah had dedicated to the Lord, along with his own sacred offerings and all the gold found in the treasuries of the house of the Lord and the royal palace, and sent it to Hazael. Then Hazael withdrew from Jerusalem.
